lane: كَاغَدٌ , (Msb, K,) and كَاغِدٌ, (L, TA,) _Paper;_ syn. قِرْطَاسٌ [which seems to be properly _paper made of the papyrus_]: (K:) a Persian word, (L,) arabicized. (L, K.) The د is sometimes changed into ذ, (Msb, TA,) and into ط. (TA.)
